comment: Hand edits applied by pads.py build. remove: pad ids to drop. names: id -> display name. add: pads the scan cannot find, each {id, name, pos: [x, y, deck z], yaw, radius, note}; they get the same deck check as found pads. The spaceport (Phantom Liberty, q306) has no pad meshes in the open-world sectors, so its spots are picked from the nav map (flat, open sky, 12 m radius).
